Jordan / Elena —

Thanks for the context. Recommend we proceed by issuing a credit memo referencing INV-2049 and then applying that credit to the Feb invoice during billing close — this leaves a clear audit trail in NetSuite. Operational notes below.

Recommended treatment:
- Documented artifact: issue Credit Memo (CM) referencing original invoice INV-2049 and the Deal ID DL-2026-009.
- GL mapping: reduce Unbilled Revenue / Contra Revenue account — suggested contra revenue GLA 4-1205-00 (promo allowances).
- Tax: non-taxable adjustment; confirm with Brightwell if tax was originally applied on INV-2049 (if tax was charged, we will issue the CM as tax-adjusted).
- Journal entry on posting of CM:
  - Debit: Sales Allowance (4-1205-00) $18,000
  - Credit: Accounts Receivable (1-1200-00) $18,000
- Timing: create CM this week, post during Feb close, then apply CM to Feb invoice.

I've prepared a draft credit memo and a short mapping workbook — attaching both. Please review and, Elena, confirm if Brightwell will accept the CM and whether you require a signed consent email for our records. If Brightwell prefers a straight offset without a CM, note that we'll need an approval email from your procurement signed by an authorized approver to keep audit trail intact.

Attachments: credit_memo_draft.pdf, accounting_notes.xlsx

Let me know if you want me to create the CM and route for posting, or if Sales will request the offset route.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Revenue Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>

Laura — agree with CM + apply approach. A couple of operational points from Billing: 

1) NetSuite reference: when we create the CM we'll set "Applied To" = INV-2049 and include a memo: "Promo credit — DL-2026-009 — per customer request". Please include the PO/authorization in the memo if Brightwell provides it.

2) Required customer artifact: Brightwell needs to confirm acceptance of the credit memo. We accept an approval email from ar@brightwell.com or a signed DocuSign consent. If they provide only a PO, we still need the explicit acceptance (email) to proceed.

3) Booking impact: posting the CM will create a short-term reduction in AR; when we apply to Feb invoice we clear both sides. For your workbook: ensure the CM has the revenue allowance GLA as Laura suggested, and add a sub-ledger tag "marketing_promo" so we can report promotional discounts separately.

If Sales (Jordan) needs this expedited to unblock the PO release, I can draft CM, route it for accounting approval, and hold posting until receipt of customer approval.

—Marcus
